name: lexv2-runtime
description: This section contains documentation for the Amazon Lex V2 Runtime V2 API operations

subcommands.name: delete-session
subcommands.description: Removes session information for a specified bot, alias, and user ID.

options.name: --bot-id
options.description: The identifier of the bot that contains the session data

options.name: --bot-alias-id
options.description: The alias identifier in use for the bot that contains the session data

options.name: --locale-id
options.description: The locale where the session is in use

options.name: --session-id
options.description: The identifier of the session to delete

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: get-session
subcommands.description: Returns session information for a specified bot, alias, and user.

options.name: --bot-id
options.description: The identifier of the bot that contains the session data

options.name: --bot-alias-id
options.description: The alias identifier in use for the bot that contains the session data

options.name: --locale-id
options.description: The locale where the session is in use

options.name: --session-id
options.description: The identifier of the session to return

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: put-session
subcommands.description: Creates a new session or modifies an existing session with an Amazon Lex V2 bot.

options.name: --bot-id
options.description: The identifier of the bot that receives the session data

options.name: --bot-alias-id
options.description: The alias identifier of the bot that receives the session data

options.name: --locale-id
options.description: The locale where the session is in use

options.name: --session-id
options.description: The identifier of the session that receives the session data

options.name: --messages
options.description: A list of messages to send to the user.

options.name: --session-state
options.description: Sets the state of the session with the user.

options.name: --request-attributes
options.description: Request-specific information passed between Amazon Lex V2 and the client application.

options.name: --response-content-type
options.description: The message that Amazon Lex V2 returns in the response can be either text or speech depending on the value of this parameter.

options.name: outfile
options.description: Filename where the content will be saved

subcommands.name: recognize-text
subcommands.description: Sends user input to Amazon Lex V2.

options.name: --bot-id
options.description: The identifier of the bot that processes the request

options.name: --bot-alias-id
options.description: The alias identifier in use for the bot that processes the request

options.name: --locale-id
options.description: The locale where the session is in use

options.name: --session-id
options.description: The identifier of the user session that is having the conversation

options.name: --text
options.description: The text that the user entered.

options.name: --session-state
options.description: The current state of the dialog between the user and the bot

options.name: --request-attributes
options.description: Request-specific information passed between the client application and Amazon Lex V2 The namespace x-amz-lex: is reserved for special attributes.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: recognize-utterance
subcommands.description: Sends user input to Amazon Lex V2.

options.name: --bot-id
options.description: The identifier of the bot that should receive the request

options.name: --bot-alias-id
options.description: The alias identifier in use for the bot that should receive the request

options.name: --locale-id
options.description: The locale where the session is in use

options.name: --session-id
options.description: The identifier of the session in use

options.name: --session-state
options.description: Sets the state of the session with the user.

options.name: --request-attributes
options.description: Request-specific information passed between the client application and Amazon Lex V2 The namespace x-amz-lex: is reserved for special attributes.

options.name: --request-content-type
options.description: Indicates the format for audio input or that the content is text.

options.name: --response-content-type
options.description: The message that Amazon Lex V2 returns in the response can be either text or speech based on the responseContentType value.

options.name: --input-stream
options.description: User input in PCM or Opus audio format or text format as described in the requestContentType parameter

options.name: outfile
options.description: Filename where the content will be saved
